messages:
maria: CI red on linux-x86-64 run for TestEphemeralSocket — failing 3/20 in last 24h, flaky.

maria: failure looks like hang in accept loop, test times out at 30s with no stacktrace.

ci-bot: Build #4123: test failure detected in job linux-x86-64; artifacts: https://ci.internal/reports/4123 (logs attached)

devon: can you paste the failing log snippet?

maria: sure — here's the tail:
```text
[ RUN      ] TestEphemeralSocket/AcceptTimeout
runtime: accept timeout after 30000ms
error: socket closed unexpectedly
```

anil: hmm "socket closed unexpectedly" usually from race in teardown; could be test tearing down server while client still connecting.

suzanne: is this similar to the ephem-socket flake we saw last month? different stack but same symptoms.

devon: request: can we rerun the flaky test with extra logging and repeated runs? I'll queue a rerun with TEST_REPEAT=50.

ci-bot: Rerun queued: job 4123-rerun-repeat-50 started.

maria: also adding `SOCKET_LATENCY_MS=50` env to simulate noisy networks.

anil: if it reproduces, let's bisect range HEAD~200..HEAD and narrow to commit that introduced nondet teardown.

suzanne: quick local repro idea: run `./scripts/stress_test.sh TestEphemeralSocket 100` on a N1-standard; add `--sanitize=thread`.

devon: note: flaky reproduces more on 8-concurrency workers — maybe a thread scheduling issue.

maria: thanks — I'll watch the rerun and attach core dumps if it crashes. ping me with results.

ci-bot: Rerun complete: 7/50 failures — artifacts: https://ci.internal/artifacts/4123-rerun-repeat-50/logs.tar.gz

maria: got artifacts, starting quick triage. grep hits for \"socket closed\":
```
logs/.../test_log.txt: error: socket closed unexpectedly at runtime/serve/listener.go:142
```

anil: can someone add a small repro harness that loops connect/disconnect with randomized short sleeps? I can run bisect then.

suzanne: @devon can you open a bisect job and tag me? I'll run on an M1 to see arch differences.

devon: will do. opening bisect job (job id: 5234567901) with range HEAD~240..HEAD and test-only patch. assigning @suzanne @anil

maria: TY. I'll add a flaky test label and mark test as flaky in CI to avoid blocking main until we fix.

anil: if bisect points to a scheduler change, we might need a synchronization fix in accept path.

suzanne: ok following up in bisect thread. closing here for now — re-open if rerun shows new symptoms :thumbsup:
